text_to_image_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create the requested production spatial reference for an existing fictional Rian Thalys story location. Image 1 locks the connected spatial geometry; later images lock the existing visual appearance. Natural submerged reef passage: shallow pale sand central channel, lavender blue coral and kelp on both sides, tall natural limestone cave arch toward BACK RIGHT, translucent turquoise water and sunshafts. This is natural terrain, NO buildings. Show terrain sections instead of building elevations. Fish can be omitted. Asset type: architectural/set reference BOARD. A portrait 9:16 page with THREE clearly separated stacked orthographic studies of the SAME fixed space: main elevation, perpendicular side elevation or longitudinal section, and a row of 3 material/detail closeups from the reference. Fine accurate architectural linework blended with lightly shaded ivory, pale blue and gold materials. Show wall/arch heights and openings coherently without numerical dimensions. For natural reef/cave use terrain cross-sections and stone/coral details, NOT invented buildings. Short English headings only ELEVATION, SECTION, DETAILS. No isometric hero view and no floor plan on this board. Preserve exact existing anchors and materials. Unseen surfaces minimally completed, no new story props. Clear legible professional reference; no watermark.
